name: Gate
rootCause: On April 21, 2018, Gate.io suffered a large-scale theft attributed to private key compromise, resulting in losses estimated at $235 million. Official technical details, affected wallet lists, and recovery status remain undisclosed; all established loss figures and chain activity come from secondary investigator reports. Gate.io’s operational wallet private keys were compromised, enabling the attacker to conduct direct mass withdrawals. The specific method of compromise (phishing, insider, infrastructure attack, or key management flaw) is not publicly documented.
